model: VLT HVAC Drive FC 102 with BACnet/IP MCA 125
applies_to: Danfoss VLT HVAC Drive FC 102 fitted with the MCA 125 BACnet/IP option card.
summary: The MCA 125 is a plug-in option that puts a VLT HVAC Drive FC 102 on BACnet IP. It publishes the drive's I/O, speed, power, alarm words and control bits as fixed objects, plus 30 user-mappable custom AV objects (AV:102 to AV:131) set in parameter 8-77. Many objects only respond when the matching I/O option (MCB 101/109/113/114/115) or a CBM license is present.
firmware: FC 102 software 9.7x; MCA 125 software 3.05 (custom objects need 3.05 or later)
notes: Device instance comes from parameter 8-70 (default 1) unless the MCA 125 DIP switches set it.
Points marked 'needs MCB ...' only work when that I/O option is installed.
CBM (condition-based monitoring) objects need a CBM license in the drive.
AV:102-AV:131 are custom objects; their names and units follow the drive parameters mapped in 8-77.
This file lists objects the guide marks for FC 102 or for both drive series; FC 202-only objects are left out.
Write Control Timeout (8-03/8-04) logic is triggered by writes to the run/reference objects.

source.title: VLT BACnet/IP MCA 125 Programming Guide (VLT HVAC Drive FC 102, VLT AQUA Drive FC 202)

integration.summary: Give the drive a unique instance in 8-70 and an IP address in 12-0*, then write BV:1 RUN/STOP command and AV:1 Input reference 1 (%). Read BV:4 RUN/STOP monitor, BV:5 OK/FAULT monitor and AV:0/AV:5/AV:6 for speed, current and power, and use BV:3 to reset trips. Set 8-03/8-04 so the drive goes to a known state if the BMS stops writing.

minimum_points.name: Input reference 1
minimum_points.why: Speed reference in %; writes also restart the 8-03 timeout

minimum_points.name: HAND/AUTO reference
minimum_points.why: Shows if the drive is in Hand

integration.heartbeat: Parameter 8-03 Control Timeout Time (0.5-18000 s, factory 60.0 s) restarts on every write to any AO, AV 1/2/31, BV 1/2/25/26/27 or MSV 1. If the BMS stops writing for longer than that, the drive raises alarm 17 Ctrl.word TO and does whatever 8-04 Control Timeout Function selects (factory Off; options include stop and trip or max speed). 8-05 End-of-Timeout Function (factory Resume setup) sets what happens when writes resume. Danfoss suggests about 3 writes per timeout window.
integration.remote_sensors: The BMS can write the PID feedback to AV:31 Bus feedback 1 (parameter 8-94) and the PID setpoint to AV:30 Setpoint 1 (parameter 20-21). Writing AV:31 also restarts the control timeout.
setup: Device instance is parameter 8-70 (factory 1, range 0-4194302); the MCA 125 DIP switches override it unless they are all On or all Off.
IP address: 12-00 selects Manual, DHCP or BOOTP; manual addresses go in 12-01 to 12-03 and need a power cycle.
Foreign-device registration: BBMD address 12-75 (0.0.0.0 disables), port 12-76, re-register interval 12-77.
8-74 sends I-Am at power-up only (factory) or about once a minute; 8-75 holds the reinitialize password (default admin).
gotchas: The MCA 125 shares the 8-7* BACnet parameters with the built-in MS/TP port, so connect the drive to only one BACnet network.
The guide does not say which drive parameters (control site, control word source, reference source) must be set for bus control; check the drive programming guide.
Many objects need an option card (MCB 101/109/113/114/115, MCO) or a CBM license and are dead without it.
AV:102-AV:131 are blank until parameter 8-77 maps a drive parameter; unmapped ones are out of service or 'Not Configured'.
Warning 34 Fieldbus fault is suppressed for 60 s after power-up; 12-78 can flag a duplicate device instance.
The timeout trigger table also lists AV 36 and AV 41, which do not appear in the object tables.
